resolution: braille.lines agree. Both `print.blocks[0].level` and `[1].level` resolved to 1 (centered): line 2's indent 16 and line 3's indent 15 each match (40-len)/2 for their own text exactly -- confirmed directly, not assumed from either run's prose. During model-building verification (node Emboss/scripts/gold-run.mjs --section section-4), two print.blocks text corrections were needed and made: the paragraph's hyphen needed to be a real em dash (“changes—passages”, which UEB renders with a comma-hyphen indicator matching the gold braille) and the sentence needed to continue to “place to another,” (comma, not a period -- the source is cut off mid-clause, not at a sentence end) to reproduce the gold braille's own wrapping exactly. With both corrections, example-4-3 is a byte-for-byte MATCH.
